waivers.verdict: Wednesday's run is done: Strange and Jacksonville both went elsewhere for $0, and no FAAB was spent. Denver is in for Chicago and starts this week. Lamar stays on the bench unless he's ruled out Friday, then he goes back on IR. Nothing else on the wire clears the bar.

lineup.verdict: No changes. Jackson's Out closes Thursday's close call — Bryce Young stays at SUPER_FLEX. Rest of the lineup holds as set.

trades.verdict: Decline sweeneyb's Keenan Allen-for-Cousins offer. Send annaf23 Cousins and Juwan Johnson for Brock Bowers as a best-and-final offer: it projects better in every window, even if Lamar never returns.

inactives.verdict: Hold — every starter is active; no pivot needed.

actions.message: Cousins and Juwan Johnson for Bowers, best and final. You're starting Watson and McKee in a superflex with 6-pt pass TDs. Cousins is averaging 24 a game and would start for you every week, and you'd have LaPorta and Johnson at TE.

evidence.note: Bowers was limited in practice Oct 21 (hamstring/calf), then played Week 7. He has played 84% of snaps over his last three games. His September knee scope cost him Weeks 1-2 only.

actions.why: Bowers starts over Kraft (14 a week vs 9). Cousins sits on my bench but would start at QB for them over McKee. Johnson becomes my third TE once Bowers arrives.

case.starts: Brock Bowers starts over Tucker Kraft at TE
